issue_context.title: Support `BatchPointGet` for Range and List Partition
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
We could support  `BatchPointGet` plan for Range and List Partition and remove the code below. https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/e68c8ff2a59817920b5ab7c1db4eb9a2ed7fff4c/planner/core/find_best_task.go#L1126-L1134

Some things need to consider,
1. https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/45702
2. Explain info, like https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/45888
3. https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/45720
4. https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/45889
5. https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/6b536ae1cb5cf39e15008621df7907bce7a7a1fa/server/conn.go#L1875, `prefetchPointPlanKeys` function, not sure if this will affect.

Most test cases are added in `TestBatchPointGetTablePartition`, but please take care about all of them.
